From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Date: 2029-06-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Gate check: AuroraCode late-stage surge provisioning (AC-1897)

Team —

AuroraCode is at signature and wants a short runway for a burst of dedicated nodes the week following PO. Request: hold ~8 A100-equivalent gpus for 4 weeks with a hard decomm trigger if they don’t convert by EOW. Can infra confirm:

- Do we have 8 A100-equivalent GPUs available in us-west for a 4-week soft hold?
- What’s the recommended hold mechanism (reservation vs. soft-standby)?
- Any billing caveats if we need a multi-week buffer before commitment?

I’ve attached the deal MAP they sent (proposed-MAP-AuroraCode-AC-1897.pdf). Need a go/no-go for offering a 4-week soft hold by EOD Friday so sales can lock terms.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-06-02T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Gate check: AuroraCode late-stage surge provisioning (AC-1897)

Soojin —

Quick inventory check attached (gpu-inventory-snapshot-20290602.csv). Short answer: we can cover an 8-GPU hold in us-west but with these constraints:

- Current flexible pool has 12 A100-equivalent available over the 2-week horizon; after that, planned capacity reclaims start on 2029-06-18 for maintenance + reserved internal projects.
- Recommend "soft standby" (ephemeral allocation with a tokenized hold and decommit rule). This prevents hard commit of GPUs but prevents other deals from immediate allocation.
- Ops requires a trigger window for decommit: 48-hour notice if they decline, otherwise auto-allocate to deal on signature. We can set an auto-release at 4 weeks from activation if not converted.

Notes: If we convert to a hard Reserved capacity (Dedicated) we need 10 business days to prep and QA the nodes for P95 latency guarantees. For a 4-week soft hold, the billing model should be a nominal hold fee (we can set 10% of the monthly unit price prorated) to discourage speculative holds.

Logan
Logan Wright
Director, Infrastructure Planning | Redwood Inference

Hi Jen —

Thanks for the productive call earlier. Per our internal availability check we can offer a 4-week soft standby for 8 A100-equivalent GPUs in us-west. High-level terms:

- Soft standby hold: 8 GPUs reserved in allocation pool, auto-release after 28 days if not converted.
- Decommit trigger: AuroraCode to confirm activation within 48 hours of signature; otherwise Redwood will auto-release.
- Hold fee: 10% of the monthly unit price prorated over the hold period (applies only during the soft standby).
- If you need an SLA-backed Dedicated pool we require ~10 business days lead time and produce a separate Dedicated SOW.

Attached: proposed-MAP-AuroraCode-AC-1897.pdf (deal MAP). Can you confirm you want us to place the soft standby hold starting Monday 2029-06-10? If yes, I’ll instruct Infra to place the hold and loop Billing for the interim invoice.

Best,
Soojin
